shots.visual: On a school rooftop in the morning, a confident Pakistani woman teacher in a green shalwar kameez and a white dupatta stands as the green and white national flag of Pakistan waves behind her, then turns to the camera; quick push-in to a close-up.

Fast push through a museum gallery lined with large old black-and-white photographs of crowds and historic buildings, faces and details soft and unreadable, as students in modest dress walk past and gaze at them. No maps anywhere in the frame.
Sweeping aerial shot from snowy northern mountains down along the Indus river to green farmland and a busy modern city.
Rising crane shot over a school morning assembly, pupils in neat rows in a sunlit yard.

In a sunlit school corridor, a confident Pakistani woman teacher in a green shalwar kameez and a white dupatta walks briskly toward the camera, holds up a phone with a blurred screen and smiles; fast push-in to a close-up as pupils walk past softly in the background.
